name: paid-media-planner
displayName: Paid Media Campaign Planner by GrowthCast
description: Plan paid media campaigns on a node canvas (campaign → ad set → ad) across Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, X, Pinterest and Snapchat. Mock every ad in its network's native format, get Claude's review, and hand off a brief, build sheet and checklist for sign-off and execution.
